decision.observation: It is Wednesday the 3rd at 6:00 a.m. The farmer is inside the farmhouse with full energy; money fell from 500g to 450g overnight.
decision.hypothesis: Leaving now and traveling toward the southeast beach will allow enough time to find Willy and receive the promised item.
decision.memory: Willy's letter asks the farmer to visit the beach. The Fish Shop is on the southeast coast and opens 9:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. The farmhouse exit is the bottom-left doorway; staying out until after midnight cost 50g.
